attributes.name: Call Animal
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1d8 to any check to acquire a card that has the Animal trait. 

Discard this card to search your deck for a card that has the Animal trait and draw it.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may attempt a Divine 6 check to recharge it instead.
